clock_hz.doc: Supplied chip clock for runtime payload periods; not a measured oscillator or a hardware identity.

uart_baud.doc: Requested UART 8N1 rate; integer bit periods approximate this rate.

spi_hz.doc: Requested mode-0 SPI SCK rate; clocked periods must be even.

i2c_hz.doc: Requested Standard/Fast-mode I2C rate ceiling (up to 400 kHz); symmetric cells are rounded up to satisfy nominal bus timing.

i2c_guard_ns.doc: Extra nominal clock margin beyond UM10204 Standard/Fast-mode low/high minima, in nanoseconds; does not characterize pads.
